comment: Shopping mall after D-mall-1: upstream's 12-block atrium (_0 and _1 at 6 rows each) with the escalator and its cobblestone-wall supports as upstream lays them, and the pitch from the mezzanine (_2) up, every quarter repeating its window row (y3). Positions are offsets from `locate shopping00`, which gives the center (local 8, 8) of the mall's north-west quarter at the city ground. Local x 0-31 runs east over shopping00/10, local z 0-31 south over shopping00/01. The escalator is at local x 8-11, climbing south from z 5 (y 1) to the mezzanine slab at z 16 (y 12); the mezzanine stair is at local x 27, z 24-28, climbing south into the first upper floor (slab y 20 at pitch 8).
title: Shopping mall: upstream atrium, pitch from the mezzanine up

shots.name: ext-se
shots.caption: Outside, from the south-east: the whole mall, both east-side window bands.
